description: This file defines the CandidateAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It implements REST API endpoints for managing candidates, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate records. It also handles attaching/detaching candidates to vacancies and maintains candidate history. The class utilizes various traits for services and helpers, and integrates with the entity and validation layers.
external_methods: getCandidateDao() (method from CandidateService or DAO layer)

classes.name: CandidateAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for candidate management within the recruitment module, including list, create, retrieve, update, delete, and vacancy association functionalities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch list of candidates with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new candidate record, optionally associating with a vacancy, and logs the creation in candidate history.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific candidate by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates candidate information and manages vacancy associations, logging changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes candidates identified by IDs from the system.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a candidate.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a candidate by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a candidate.
